title.zh: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
title.en: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%

current_state.zh: US equities opened sharply lower with the Nasdaq down 2.2% as the tech selloff deepened, led by Intel's 25.7% plunge on weak PC demand and cash-flow concerns and Amazon's 5.3% drop after soft Q4 guidance, while energy names like Exxon gained.
